summary: Decompresses a block-based alpha channel: calls the color decompressor on a2+4 first, and only proceeds when it succeeds; builds an 8-entry float alpha lookup table from two reference bytes (a2[0], a2[1]) scaled by 0.0039215689 (5-step interpolation plus fixed 0.0/1.0 endpoints when alpha0<=alpha1, 7-step interpolation otherwise), then unpacks two 24-bit selectors as eight 3-bit indices each and writes the selected palette entries into the A slot of 8 float4 texels at a1+3 and of another 8 at a1+35.

local_names.a1: destination float4 texel array; A slot of texel n at a1+4n+3
local_names.a2: source block header: reference alpha bytes then packed 3-bit selectors
local_names.v19: base of the 8-entry float alpha palette built from a2[0]/a2[1]

operations.description: Call KeyframeQuadInterpolationWithBitPackedSelector(a1, a2+4) to decompress the color half of the block; its return value gates all further work.
Only proceed when the color-decompressor result is >= 0; otherwise return that result immediately.
Read the two reference alpha bytes from a2[0] and a2[1] and scale each by 0.0039215689 into alpha0 and alpha1.
Branch on alpha0 <= alpha1: build a 5-step interpolation palette and pin palette[6]=0.0 and palette[7]=1.0; otherwise build a 7-step interpolation palette.
5-step mode: for i = 1..4 compute palette[i] = ((5-i)*alpha0 + i*alpha1) * 0.2.
7-step mode: for j = 1..6 compute palette[j] = ((7-j)*alpha0 + j*alpha1) * 0.14285715.
Assemble the first 24-bit selector from a2 bytes 2..4 and the second from bytes 5..7.
Unpack the first selector as eight 3-bit indices; write the palette entry for each index into the A slot of 8 float4 texels starting at a1+3, stepping 4 floats (this+0xC).
Unpack the second selector as eight 3-bit indices; write the palette entry for each index into the A slot of the next 8 float4 texels starting at a1+35, stepping 4 floats (this+0x8C).
Return 0 on success; on a failed color decompress, return the caller-supplied negative result.

clean_pseudocode: for (int i = 1; i < 5; ++i) palette[i] = ((5 - i) * palette[0] + i * palette[1]) * 0.2f;
for (int j = 1; j < 7; ++j) palette[j] = ((7 - j) * palette[0] + j * palette[1]) * 0.14285715f;
for (int n = 0; n < 8; ++n) { a1[3 + 4 * n] = palette[sel1 & 7]; sel1 >>= 3; }
for (int n = 0; n < 8; ++n) { a1[35 + 4 * n] = palette[sel2 & 7]; sel2 >>= 3; }
